zh.title: 瑞安航空導入Google雲端服務以支援營運決策
zh.summary: 瑞安航空導入Google雲端服務；利用AI技術協助機組人員排班與營運決策
body: 瑞安航空（Ryanair）宣布與Google Cloud達成為期5年的雲端合作夥伴關係，將於公司業務中導入Google Gemini人工智慧工具與DeepMind模型。
該計畫旨在利用相關技術協助安排機組人員班表並做出營運決策，並透過開發客製化AI代理來實現部分決策流程自動化，以減少營運中斷。
瑞安航空執行長威爾森（Eddie Wilson）表示，新的雙雲端策略將提供基礎設施韌性，以支持公司成長目標。
此舉是在該公司既有的亞馬遜網路服務（AWS）基礎上新增的舉措，旨在降低技術故障風險。
瑞安航空目標在2034年達到每年載客3億人次。

en.title: Ryanair to adopt Google Cloud services for operational decision-making
en.summary: Ryanair to implement Google Cloud services; utilizing AI for crew scheduling and operational decisions
body: Ryanair has announced a five-year cloud partnership with Google Cloud to integrate Google Gemini AI tools and DeepMind models into its business operations.
The airline intends to use Gemini Enterprise to develop custom AI agents to automate certain decision processes, improve crew scheduling, and reduce operational disruptions.
The company will also utilize Google DeepMind models, including AlphaEvolve and WeatherNext, to support fleet operations and maintenance scheduling.
This initiative builds upon Ryanair's existing use of Amazon Web Services (AWS) as part of a dual-cloud strategy to enhance infrastructure resilience and mitigate technical failure risks.
Ryanair aims to reach an annual passenger capacity of 300 million by 2034.
